page.overview:
Who is Boaz Pearlmutter?

Boaz Pearlmutter is a fictional intelligence operative based in Israel. The character appeared in the 2015 video-game James Bond: World of Espionage.

After the breakdown of his second marriage, Boaz left Canada and moved to Israel for a fresh start. He is one of the few working intelligence agents with excellent ties to both Mossad and the Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS). He has skills in smuggling, jewelcraft and piloting, and is multi-lingual, speaking French, English, Hebrew and Russian. The character offers a defence buff and provides a +10 bonus to total offence using bulletproof briefcases and a 1HP bonus to the Finishing Move threshold using passenger jets. He is an "uncommon agent" (green) and can be levelled to level 15.
